tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Webdeveloper | SAP Commerce Cloud & Java Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms. Strong Java, Spring, Spring Boot and RESTful API expertise. Proven delivery of headless commerce, PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and agile Scrum teams. Techno-functional experience translating business needs into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: E-Commerce Webdeveloper Shopify
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Kijimea because of its innovative approach to building high-performing Shopify stores for health-focused brands. With over five years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in headless e-commerce, API integration and agile delivery that can accelerate your Shopify initiatives.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Platform Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, handling product catalogs, pricing and order management, demonstrating the ability to architect robust e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST Web Services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless data flow—experience directly applicable to Shopify API integrations.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & DevOps
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes, and led production support, delivering features rapidly within Scrum teams, matching the fast-paced Shopify development cycles.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Business Analysis
bullets.text: I worked closely with international stakeholders to translate business requirements into user stories and functional specs, enabling precise implementation and user acceptance testing.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Kijimea.

tailoring.why_company: Kijimea’s focus on creating premium health-and-beauty brands through cutting-edge Shopify experiences aligns with my passion for delivering high-performance e-commerce solutions. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help scale your Shopify stores, improve integration reliability and accelerate time-to-market for your innovative product lines.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to bring my proven e-commerce platform and integration expertise to Kijimea, helping you deliver fast, reliable Shopify experiences that drive growth for your health-focused brands.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years of e-commerce experience. I’m excited about Kijimea’s Shopify role and would love to discuss how I can help accelerate your projects. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for E-Commerce Webdeveloper – Shopify (Kranti Chavan)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the E-Commerce Webdeveloper Shopify position at Kijimea. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, API integration and agile delivery experience. I am eager to apply my expertise to your Shopify projects and look forward to discussing further.
